description: C2's order mirrors at the order action's unit branch 0x43F1D4: the cursor over an enemy, with the player's keyed unit and its stock twin selected in turn. nottoair: f_na (WKLLTNA) and f_llt (ARMLLT) over t_air, a WKAIR hovering (MaxVelocity 1, so the AI flies it off slowly: re-order it with tacli order before a reading). nottounderwater: f_nu (WKTLNU) and f_tl (ARMTL) over t_sub, an ARMTL on the sea floor, submerged, which the player sees through the sonar station beside it (a submerged enemy is neither drawn nor picked without one). surfacefire: the hovercraft f_hsf (WKSHSF) and f_htp (WKSHTP) over t_land, a CORSOLAR ashore. Every target is 450+ from its shooters, out of reach, so nothing is destroyed while the cursor is read (peek *0x511DE8+0x2CBE:1 the cursor, +0x2CBA the unit under it). Content: tools/datakeys_fixture.py into the instance's gamedir.
